# Contributing to Axis Workflow

Axis is developed by its maintainers. Please report bugs and request features with the issue forms, or with `^feedback` from inside your Axis session, which prepares a complete report for you and sends nothing without your approval. Questions and open-ended ideas go to [Discussions](https://github.com/AxisWorkflow/axis/discussions).

We do not accept pull requests from outside the maintainer team; pull requests are limited to collaborators. Every change has to pass Axis's release checks and carry a signed Contributor License Agreement ([`_Axis/CONTRIBUTING.md`](../_Axis/CONTRIBUTING.md)), and a good report gets a fix faster than a patch.

Security problems go to [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/AxisWorkflow/axis/security/advisories/new), never to a public issue. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

Issues are public. By submitting one, you agree that the maintainers may use its text to improve Axis.
